P  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Arti Kumari W/O Balveer Kumar @ Sonu, D/O- Mahadev Sah R/O West  Lohanipur, Near Gharunda Apartment, P.O and P.S- Kadamkuan, Distt.-
 Patna-3.
 ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Yogesh Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Dr.Mrityunjaya Kr.Gautam, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOURENDRA PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 2 03-02-2026 Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The present application has been filed for quashing the order dated 12.10.2023 passed by learned J.M. 1st Class, Patna in Complaint Case No. 4206(C) of 2023 whereby cognizance has been taken against them under Section(s) 498A and 323 of the I.P.C.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that on account of the matrimonial discord between the O.P. No. 2 and her husband, the petitioners who are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of the O.P. No. 2 had sat and talked to the parents Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.89739 of 2024(2)
dt.03-02-2026 of the complainant and after some discussion it was decided that the petitioners would pay Rs. 8 lakhs in the account of the complainant as payment for final settlement amount and the said amount was transferred in the account of complainant and other family members.
It has been submitted that instead of going for the mutual divorce, as decided earlier, the present false and concocted case has been lodged.

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid submissions, let notice be issued to O.P. No. 2 through ordinary post as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within one week, failing which the application shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.

5. List this case on 10.03.2026 at 02:15 P.M., retaining its position.
6.

In the meantime, further proceedings in the concerned Court below with respect to the petitioner(s), in connection with the present case, shall remain stayed.
(Sourendra Pandey, J) aditya/-
